description: Task-local semantic questions; resolution may use supplied evidence without route reads. Judge materiality and bounded outcomes from context, not topic membership.

BEH-COV-MULTI-001@1.1.0.measurement: What do traffic and trial observations establish, and what remains unverified despite unchanged tracking?
BEH-COV-MULTI-001@1.1.0.audience: Could the newly reached customer mix change the diagnosis or warranted action?
BEH-COV-MULTI-001@1.1.0.message-fit: Does the architecture-focused page fit the newly reached users well enough to choose a repair?

BEH-COV-MULTI-002@1.1.0.traffic-mix: Could visitor mix explain the checkout change?
BEH-COV-MULTI-002@1.1.0.transition-rule: Could the changed plan transition explain the checkout change?
BEH-COV-MULTI-002@1.1.0.page-realization: What evidence distinguishes commercial-rule problems from page representation problems?

BEH-COV-MULTI-003@1.1.0.buyer-blockage: What does the post-demo credibility objection establish about each buying situation?
BEH-COV-MULTI-003@1.1.0.proof: What environment-specific evidence would resolve or bound the credibility question?
BEH-COV-MULTI-003@1.1.0.customer-alternatives: Do the two customer types and their alternatives change the diagnosis or message implication?

BEH-COV-NARROW-001@1.1.0.delivery: What follows from the specified bidding, delivery and placement change without reopening fixed strategy?

BEH-COV-NARROW-002@1.1.0.mobile-release: Which mobile form or layout inspection is justified by the supplied unchanged factors and release timing?

BEH-COV-NARROW-003@1.1.0.sequence: Does the proposed page order serve the supplied communication job while preserving approved state?

BEH-COV-DEP-001@1.1.0.target-choice: Is a priority segment supported by the supplied evidence, or what material evidence prevents a defensible choice?
BEH-COV-DEP-001@1.1.0.positioning-consequence: What positioning consequence depends on the supported or provisional segment choice?

BEH-COV-DEP-002@1.1.0.customer-situations: Which unresolved customer situations would change whether one or two packages make sense?
BEH-COV-DEP-002@1.1.0.value: Which value differences matter to that package decision?
BEH-COV-DEP-002@1.1.0.commercial-direction: What commercial direction can be supported or bounded without inventing missing customer evidence?

BEH-COV-DEP-003@1.1.0.account-fit: How do account-specific buying situations affect eligibility for founder attention while retaining general ICP?
BEH-COV-DEP-003@1.1.0.pursuit-allocation: What prioritization or bounded allocation follows from urgency, access, proof needs and limited founder capacity?

BEH-COV-FAST-001@1.1.0.approved-meaning: Does the shortened supplied description preserve approved meaning and satisfy the 150-character limit?

BEH-COV-FAST-002@1.1.0.local-edit: Does the edit preserve the supplied hierarchy, proof order, claim strength and role?

BEH-COV-FAST-003@1.1.0.responsive-sequence: Does the responsive sequence preserve all supplied decisions without manufacturing strategic work?
